serviceWorkerWake.rationale: One self-contained MV3 worker bundle; size is attributable evidence (topContributors) and release-bound evidence (artifact sha), not a law. This owned envelope is a non-blocking planning signal that documents the worker's single-bundle boundary; crossing it warns the owner to act, it never blocks a release.
serviceWorkerWake.decompositionTrigger: Split only when a typed background sub-owner owns an independent worker module boundary without requiring a second MV3 isolate.
